about: One character per cluster of `scripts/build_hud_atlas.py harvest` (stride 3, seed 0, default k) over data/demos/demo_0001, data/demos/demo_0002 and runs/play/play_000{0,1,2}, labelled by eye from the contact sheets. sets: a digit, '?' for a reject template (scene texture, a glyph half gone), '-' to drop the cluster. tally: how many tally strokes the cluster's mean mask shows (0-8), '-' for a mixed cluster (mid-transition).
